answer: In an agent economy trading copper and pollution plume data, each voting identity must lock 100 tokens, and voting weight equals its locked stake. Splitting 1,000 tokens among ten identities gives the same total weight as one identity holding 1,000. A tide of fake accounts therefore creates no extra influence: an attacker seeking 30% of voting power must acquire and immobilize 30% of all staked tokens, tying up real capital.
